title: LibTorch's torch::cat() crashes in debug mode

labels.name: triaged
labels.description: This issue has been looked at a team member, and triaged and prioritized into an appropriate module

labels.name: module: assert failure
labels.description: The issue involves an assert failure

body:
## Issue description

torch::cat() crashes in debug mode using CPU tensors and LibTorch 1.12. The error is "invalid IListRef tag" at line 403 of ATen/core/IListRef.h:
```
"false INTERNAL ASSERT FAILED at \"C:\\\\actions-runner\\\\_work\\\\pytorch\\\\pytorch\\\\builder\\\\windows\\\\pytorch\\\\aten\\\\src\\\\ATen/core/IListRef.h\":403, please report a bug to PyTorch. invalid IListRef tag."
```

I downloaded the precompiled library via https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally/. I created a MSVC 2019 project and copied all the LibTorch DLL files into the same folder as the generated EXE. I had previously installed PyTorch via conda on this system, and I'm not sure if there is some issue there. Incidentally, the CPP code does not detect CUDA but my PyTorch installation does.

## Code example

```c++
#include <torch/all.h>
#include <iostream>

void main() 
{
  // Using "libtorch-win-shared-with-deps-debug-1.12.1+cu116", the following error occurs in torch::cat():
  // "false INTERNAL ASSERT FAILED at \"C:\\\\actions-runner\\\\_work\\\\pytorch\\\\pytorch\\\\builder\\\\windows\\\\pytorch\\\\aten\\\\src\\\\ATen/core/IListRef.h\":403, please report a bug to PyTorch. invalid IListRef tag."
  // But using Release version "libtorch-win-shared-with-deps-1.12.1+cu116", the following executes fine.
  // The same error occurs for the CPU-only debug version "libtorch-win-shared-with-deps-debug-1.12.1+cpu"
  // But does not occur for the CPU-only release version "libtorch-win-shared-with-deps-1.12.1+cpu"
  auto x = torch::rand({ 3, 3 });
  auto y = torch::rand({ x.size(0), 2 });
  auto z = torch::cat({ x,y }, 1);
  std::cout << x << std::endl;
  std::cout << y << std::endl;
  std::cout << z << std::endl;
}
```
